topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, oncogene discovery, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the historical discovery of tumor viruses and explain how retroviral oncogene capture and transformation assays established the cellular origin of oncogenes.

topics.label: Classification and functional mechanisms of cancer mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the classification of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and demonstrate how their mutations disrupt cell cycle control and protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the distinct pathways of DNA repair failure, replication error, and mitotic malfunction that produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how stepwise mutation accumulation and inherited genetic predispositions accelerate tumor development and influence malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with suggested reading and closing housekeeping remarks.
